description: Machine-readable index of AVP conformance vectors. A harness can enumerate this instead of hardcoding filenames. Prose explanation: vectors/README.md. Each entry: file (relative to vectors/), kind, specSection, and the published anchors a conformant implementation must reproduce.

kinds.deterministic: Pure byte/string construction with no key material; must match exactly.
kinds.rfc-primitive: A cryptographic primitive pinned to a published RFC test vector.
kinds.composition: Full AVP composition with fixed keys/IVs; reproduce byte-for-byte and round-trip (decrypt/unwrap/verify).
kinds.negative: A valid construction with one mutation that a conformant implementation MUST reject.

vectors.construction: 24-word BIP39 English mnemonic of 32-byte entropy (wordlist bip39-english.txt); seed = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(NFKD(mnemonic), "mnemonic" || NFKD(passphrase), 2048, 64); ed25519Seed / x25519Private = HKDF-SHA256(seed, empty, "avp/owner/ed25519/v1" / "avp/owner/x25519/v1", 32)
vectors.expects: mnemonic, seed, owner Ed25519 seed and public key, owner X25519 private and public key; the Trezor anchors reproduce with passphrase TREZOR

vectors.construction: S = CE(tag "avp/manifest/v1", ...) with sorted hosts, members, removals, frontier; ownerSignature = Ed25519(ownerKey, S); manifestHash = SHA-256(S || ownerSignature); repoId = base64url-nopad(SHA-256(CE(tag "avp/repo-id/v1", bytes(ownerKey), bytes(genesisNonce)))[0..16])
vectors.expects: stateHex, ownerSignature, manifestHashHex, and repoId at seq 1, independent of list input order

vectors.construction: H = CE(tag "avp/commit/v1", ...) with sorted parents; commitId = SHA-256(H); authorSignature = Ed25519(author, CE(tag "avp/commit-sig/v1", bytes(commitId))); AAD v2 = CE(tag "avp/aad/v2", str(repoId), i64(keyEpoch), bytes(author), sorted parents); AES-256-GCM, 12-byte IV, 16-byte tag appended
vectors.expects: headerHex, commitIdHex, authorSignature, aadHex, and ciphertext, independent of parent order; decrypt recovers plaintextUtf8
public key derived from seed; deterministic signature reproduced and verified
vectors.note: Anchors the challenge -> token signature: signing the raw nonce bytes is this primitive.

vectors.construction: X25519-HKDF-SHA256-AESGCM-v1: KEK = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=X25519(eph,recip), salt=ephPubRaw, info=UTF8("avp/rdk-wrap/v1")); AES-256-GCM(KEK, iv, aad=UTF8("avp/rdk-wrap/v1"), dataKey)
vectors.expects: recompute shared secret + KEK; re-wrap equals committed ciphertext; unwrap recovers the data key
vectors.note: recipientPrivateKeyB64, sharedSecretHex, kekHex are checker aids, NOT part of the wire WrappedKey

vectors.construction: base64url (no padding) over compact JSON for the join-handshake tokens (InviteRequest, RepoLocator); avp://<host>/<repoId> for the repository URI
vectors.expects: decoding base64url yields the object (decode oracle); canonical minified encoding round-trips; avp:// URIs parse to {host, repoId} and format back

vectors.construction: valid key-wrap / ed25519 constructions with one mutation each (flipped tag, bit flip, truncation, wrong recipient/ephemeral key, wrong message/public key)
vectors.expects: each case MUST be rejected: key-unwrap fails authentication, ed25519-verify returns false
vectors.generatedBy: vectors/generate.ts (from the same seeds as the positive vectors)
